title: Museum Audio-Guide Builder Platform
originalRequest: Develop an administrative portal and mobile client architecture for managing and delivering location-aware museum audio guides with TTS support.
latestMessage: Develop an administrative portal and mobile client architecture for managing and delivering location-aware museum audio guides with TTS support.

steps.title: Implement Bluetooth LE beacon proximity trigger system
steps.instruction: Integrate the Beacon API with the audio-guide playback service to trigger exhibit audio when the user is within 2 meters of the BLE beacon.
steps.acceptance: The application successfully detects UUID/Major/Minor beacon values and initiates the corresponding audio track playback with less than 500ms latency.
steps.result: I have configured the core BLE scanning service and successfully bound the background listener to beacon UUIDs. Currently debugging an issue where RSSI fluctuations cause rapid, repeated playback triggers at the 2-meter threshold. I am implementing an exponential moving average filter to smooth the RSSI values before finalizing the handler.

steps.title: Integrate automated multilingual Text-to-Speech (TTS) compilation
steps.instruction: Develop a backend pipeline that automatically generates audio guide tracks from exhibit text descriptions using neural TTS APIs in English, Spanish, French, and Mandarin, including speech-mark synthesis for captions.
steps.acceptance: Script generates MP3 files and associated WebVTT caption files with exact timing markers for all specified languages upon saving an exhibit description.

steps.title: Design museum floor plan interactive map editor
steps.instruction: Build a web-based canvas utility allowing administrators to upload an SVG of a museum layout and map coordinate hotspots to specific audio exhibits.
steps.acceptance: Administrators can drag and drop hotspots onto an SVG canvas, bind them to an exhibit ID, and save the coordinates to the database.

steps.title: Configure offline audio sync caching protocol
steps.instruction: Establish a progressive web app (PWA) caching mechanism utilizing Service Workers and CacheStorage to pre-download full audio guide packages for offline museum tours.
steps.acceptance: The application is fully functional in airplane mode, loading pre-cached assets and tracking local analytics to be synced once connection is restored.
